name: Himuro Akira
source:
Yui's older brother and the object of her affections. He thinks his sister is still a child and is very very protective of her. When she sneaks out at night to go 'play' with her new friend Serina he gets extremely worried and lectures her about making him worry when she gets home.

He takes care of the Himura house and is very good at cooking.
